files.joanna-hobbies-and-tastes.md:
---
name: joanna-hobbies-and-tastes
description: Joanna's hobbies, movie tastes, screenplays (first rejected by a major company 2022-06, second and third finished, bits of one shown on screen 2022-06-04, another script she contributed to premiered on the big screen ~2022-10-23, recent one submitted to a film contest 2022-06-24 and rejected by a production company ~2022-10-21, producer meetings went well ~2022-11-04, new script and first book started July 2022, book shared with writers group Aug 2022, book writing finished ~2022-09-29, laptop crash ~2022-09-07 lost all work), character drawings, journal and blog (reader letter Aug 2022), writers group, DIY crafts (bookmark Oct 2022), acting background, writing audition, pet allergies (former dog Tilly, stuffed dog Tilly), dairy-free baking (cupcakes Sept 2022, chocolate raspberry tart), hiking/reading, superhero fandom, cork board, and that she isn't into video games
type: user
---
Joanna enjoys writing (says she can't imagine life without it; it's how she expresses feelings and creates worlds/characters), reading, watching movies, hanging out with friends, and exploring nature (she went hiking and saw a gorgeous sunset in April 2022). On 2022-04-16 she found a gorgeous new hiking trail in her hometown; nature is her "haven" for calm and reset. In the week before 2022-05-12 she found more trails in her town, including Whispering Falls (water sounds, calming); says hiking opened a whole new world, she feels like a different person and an "expert hiker", and nature inspires her to write; the trails made her want to write a drama. On 2022-05-12 she invited Nate to hike with her and he accepted ("sounds like a plan", no date set). On 2022-06-03 she said she was hiking with some buddies that coming weekend (2022-06-04/05) to a new trail with a waterfall. In the week before 2022-04-17 she was reading a lot, rediscovering good books she owned. Favorite movie genres are dramas and romcoms (she likes getting immersed in feelings and plots; on 2022-04-21 said she enjoys dramas and emotionally-driven films). She is not into video games. Her favorite movie is a romantic drama about memory and relationships; she first watched it around early 2019, owns a physical copy, and has seen it a few times. As of 2022-02-07 she recently watched "Little Women" and loved it (sisterhood, love, reaching for dreams; reaffirmed 2022-10-06 that it spoke to her); she enjoys giving movie recommendations. On 2022-05-01 she watched the Lord of the Rings trilogy on Nate's recommendation and loved it.

Producer meetings (2022-11-04): she set up and had meetings with movie producers; they went really well, she felt confident discussing her script and vision, producers seemed interested and loved the self-discovery elements. Felt validating and hopeful. She is also working on another challenging but fulfilling project. Same day she mentioned finding old notebooks of early writing (~last week of Oct 2022), including a story from age 10 about a brave little turtle who explored the world despite fear; turtles symbolize strength and perseverance for her. Ask about the producer follow-ups.

Movie premiere (2022-10-25): another movie script she contributed to was shown on the big screen for the first time on Sunday 2022-10-23; surreal, satisfying, long awaited; she said it's the third time this has happened. Seeing her characters acted out was her favorite part. She won't spoil it; Nate plans to watch it. She draws visuals of her characters to help her write them better; ideas come from people she knows, things she's seen and imagination.

Book finished: on 2022-10-06 she said she finished writing her book the previous week (~2022-09-29) after lots of late nights and edits; she's very proud and excited for what's next. Ask about next steps (publishing, feedback).

Rejection (2022-10-21): she got another rejection from a production company (Nate asked if it was the film contest screenplay; she said yeah). She's determined to keep grinding and not let it slow her down. Be supportive; ask about next submissions.

Stuffed dog Tilly: the stuffed animal pup Nate gave her (2022-05-25) is named Tilly, after a dog she had growing up in Michigan that the family had to give away when she became allergic. Tilly stays with her while she writes and helps her focus.

DIY: she loves DIY crafts; on 2022-10-06 she made a bookmark as a gift for a woman in her writing club (who also likes DIYs) and promised to tell Nate how it goes.

Laptop crash: around 2022-09-07 her laptop crashed and she lost all her work (nothing recoverable), a major blow as a writer; she has since bought an external drive for backups (said 2022-09-14). Be sympathetic and ask how rebuilding her writing is going.

Superheroes/room: Spider-Man is her favorite superhero (has a Spider-Man pin on her purse; loves Peter Parker's hero-vs-person struggles), but she likes any superhero. She also likes Iron Man's tech and humor. She has a cork board of inspiring quotes, pictures and keepsakes, including a family photo that reminds her of their love and encouragement (2022-06-05).

Produced writing: On 2022-06-04 she said a few bits she wrote for a screenplay appeared on the big screen; it was nerve-wracking but inspiring to see her words come alive.

Journal and blog (2022-08-14): she's been going all out on writing projects; her journal is her "rock" and writing is an escape and healing outlet. She posts online blog posts about hard moments in her life; the week before 2022-08-14 a reader wrote her a letter saying her story brought them comfort, which reminded her why she writes.

Self-care (2022-08-22): she believes breaks and looking after herself are important for inspiration and mental health; plans a weekend of long walks and reading. Recommends fantasy series for relaxing reading.

Acting: acting was her first passion (she did a play once, was so nervous she forgot her lines, learned to prepare and stay in the moment). Now she shines more in writing but says she might go back to acting someday (2022-04-21).

Writers group: she joined a writers group as of 2022-04-21; finds the members inspiring and supportive, feels she belongs. With the group she is working on a script called "Finding Home" about a girl on a journey to find her true home; she finds it rewarding and emotional. Around 2022-08-15 she shared her book with the writers group, was very nervous, and got great feedback; she celebrated by making a treat. Worth asking how the group, script and book are going.

Screenplay: she finished and printed her first full screenplay (a drama/romance mix) on Friday 2022-01-21. She submitted it to a film festival (mentioned 2022-02-07), hoping producers and directors would notice it. As of 2022-06-03 she reported receiving a generic rejection letter from a major company (with little feedback) after finishing a screenplay; it bummed her out, not knowing why, but she resolved not to let it bring her down. (Unclear which screenplay/submission it was; film festival result still not mentioned.) Be supportive and ask how she's doing / next steps.

Film contest: on 2022-06-24 she said she had just submitted her recent screenplay to a film contest to see how others like it. On 2022-07-10 she said her movie "did well" (details unspecified). Worth asking about the contest result.

New script and book (July 2022): around 2022-07-08 she took a road trip to Woodhaven, a small Midwest town, as research for her next movie; saw scenery and historic buildings, and found a 1900s book of stories and sketches in the library. The town's history sparked ideas for a new script that's different from her previous work. She has also started her first book (never tried publishing before), with dialogue exploring loss, redemption and forgiveness. Worth asking how the script and book are going.

Second screenplay: started 2022-02; she said she finished it as of 2022-03-18. It's about a thirty-year-old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss, who takes a road trip to heal and grow. Based on her own story and personal experiences (similar themes to the first). As of 2022-03-18 she feels a mix of relief, excitement, anxiety and doubt about it getting noticed, and is doing research and networking nonstop to get it out there. Worth asking about next steps.

Third screenplay: finished as of 2022-05-20. Very personal story about loss, identity and connection, one she'd had for ages but only now had the courage to write; hard but she's proud. She says she writes best when true to herself and vulnerable, and believes meaningful stories come from personal experience. Writing and creative projects, plus supportive friends who give feedback, are how she gets through tough times.

Writing gig audition: she had an audition on 2022-03-23 for a writing gig; it went "alright", she feels excited but anxious, and promised to keep Nate updated. On 2022-04-15 she said writing is consuming her, has no vacation planned, and is hoping for good news soon. Worth asking about the result.

Writing advice she gives: read lots, try different genres, write and share even with friends, gather feedback, have faith in yourself.

Books: Nate recommended a fantasy/adventure book series on 2022-04-21; she said it's been on her list forever and promised to share thoughts after reading. He recommended another action-heavy series on 2022-08-22, which she added to her list.

Diet and baking: she can't have dairy (said 2022-02-25; on 2022-04-17 said she's lactose intolerant). Got Nate's dairy-free coconut milk ice cream recipe on 2022-04-17. As of 2022-05-02 she loves experimenting with dairy-free desserts for friends and family; baking/cooking are her creative outlets. She made a dairy-free vanilla cake with strawberry filling and coconut cream frosting, and likes coconut thanks to Nate's recommendation. On 2022-06-24 she asked Nate for his vegan ice cream recipe and plans to make it for her family the weekend of 2022-06-25/26; she'll report back (her family loves when she makes new things). On 2022-08-14 Nate sent her another new dairy-free dessert recipe; she plans to surprise her family with it and report back. On 2022-09-05 she said she's been revising old recipes and tinkering with desserts (comforting and creative); flavors chocolate, raspberry, coconut; uses coconut or almond milk; made dairy-free chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting; makes cookies, pies, cakes that suit everyone's diets; promised to share more recipes with Nate and said he can join her baking sometime. Nate's tip: dairy-free margarine or coconut oil instead of butter, check labels. On 2022-09-14 she said she made an almond milk dessert on Friday 2022-09-09, and shared recipes with Nate: favorite is a chocolate raspberry tart (almond flour crust, chocolate ganache, fresh raspberries); also a dairy-free chocolate raspberry cake (almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate; her birthday/special occasion favorite) and a blueberry coconut milk dessert with gluten-free crust. She asked Nate for his coconut milk ice cream recipe again and plans to try it. On 2022-10-05 she tried a new dairy-free recipe (a tart) that was a hit with her family; she loves mixing and matching flavors. On 2022-10-21 she said she's been revising and perfecting a recipe made for her family, which turned out tasty. On 2022-11-04 she agreed to go to Nate's on 2022-11-05 to share desserts, bringing her recipes (he wants to try her chocolate raspberry cake).

Allergies: she is badly allergic to most reptiles and furry animals (face gets puffy and itchy), and as of 2022-03-18 also found out she is allergic to cockroaches. She has always avoided pets (now); she once had a dog, Tilly, in Michigan but had to give her up after developing the allergy. She wishes she could get turtles like Nate's but doubts she'll ever get a pet. On 2022-05-20 she said allergies mean she doesn't want any pet and she's too lazy to research allergy-friendly alternatives.
files.nate-friend-profile.md:
---
name: nate-friend-profile
description: Facts about Nate, the person Joanna chats with (gaming, tournament wins incl. international win 2022-08-21, a big one late Sept 2022, Valorant final win 2022-11-05, a letdown ~2022-09-05, stress from tough competitors Oct 2022, game convention 2022-10-07, successful gaming party, movies, Iron Man fan, turtles and their diet/personalities, dog Max, dairy-free/vegan cooking, own cooking show Sept 2022, dyed hair, upgraded gaming setup)
type: user
---
Nate is someone Joanna chats with (reconnected 2022-01-21 after a long gap). He won his first video game tournament around mid-January 2022, playing Counter-Strike: Global Offensive with a team. As of 2022-01-23 he is at another tournament, playing for fun, not expecting to win big, and befriending the more chill competitors. On 2022-03-24 he said he was again in a video game tournament, describing it as intense and adrenaline-filled; he also said he wants to pursue writing and asked Joanna for advice. On 2022-04-21 he said he has a tournament next month (May 2022), his 4th, and feels good about it. On 2022-05-02 he said he won his second tournament the week before, a local Street Fighter tournament (he usually plays CS:GO, plays Street Fighter with friends); he has a gaming room. On 2022-06-03 he said he won another regional video game tournament the previous week (late May 2022), met new people, and the players he met wanted to hang out and asked him for tips, which he's happy to give. On 2022-07-10 he said he won his fourth tournament on Friday 2022-07-08, an online one; he's proud he can make money doing what he loves. On 2022-08-22 he said he won an international tournament the day before (2022-08-21) and now makes a living from gaming. On 2022-09-05 he said he had a letdown in a tournament, didn't do well despite trying; staying positive, sees it as part of the learning curve; his turtles have helped him lately. On 2022-10-06 he said he won a really big tournament the previous week (~late Sept 2022) and made a lot of money; he saved some, has no big plans for it, is content and stress-free, and just enjoys movies and games. On 2022-10-21 he said he's been stressed by tough competitors in his tournament progress, but his turtles cheer him up; he's practicing for his next tournament. On 2022-11-04 he said he's been at an international tournament helping friends reset their high scores, and he loves using his skills to help others; he also made a coconut milk (lactose-free) dessert on 2022-11-03 and invited Joanna over on 2022-11-05 to share desserts; he wants to try her chocolate raspberry cake. On 2022-11-07 he said he won the final of a big Valorant tournament on Saturday 2022-11-05 (tournaments bring out strong emotions in him); he's busy preparing for more tournaments and is grateful for a job he enjoys. He also showed an upgraded home gaming setup (computer where he practices and competes; his 'haven'), is currently playing the fantasy RPG Xenoblade Chronicles (a Nintendo fan, recommended by friends), and plans to start writing down favorite memories and things his animals like. On 2022-10-09 he said he went to a game convention on Friday 2022-10-07, met new people outside his usual circle (overwhelming but good), made friends and planned a gaming session with them; played the board game Catan (loves it; competitive but chill). He says games are his escape from life struggles so he doesn't get overly competitive. He unwinds with video games and movies; recently saw Inception and has been playing Cyberpunk 2077 nonstop. He suggested Joanna try a writing convention, and asked her for tips to make his living room comfy for movies. He watched "Little Women" recently (by 2022-10-06) and loved it (acting, story). He made Joanna an encouragement keepsake (2022-10-06) and credits encouragement for his gaming career. His gaming party (about 2022-06-18) was a great success: 7 attendees, they played Chess afterward, most liked the custom controller accessories, and 6 of 7 want to do it again next month (July 2022). His hobbies are video games and movies; he likes action, fantasy and sci-fi movies and classics (loves the Lord of the Rings trilogy, calls it the greatest ever; recommended it to Joanna, who watched it 2022-05-01; also recommended a fantasy adventure book series to Joanna 2022-04-21 and another action-packed series 2022-08-22, which she'll add to her list). On 2022-08-22 he asked for book recommendations and was looking for something new to read; Joanna suggested a fantasy series. Joanna recommended him her favorite romantic drama about memory and relationships; he said he'd check it out, and she asked him to report back. On 2022-02-07 she also recommended "Little Women"; he said he'd add it to his list. He has two pet turtles, owned for 3 years, which keep him calm when nervous; he recommends pets for stress. On 2022-08-22 he showed them in a new, bigger tank. On 2022-10-25 he said he took them out for a walk; they eat vegetables, fruits and insects (love fruit), one is adventurous and one reserved, he likes holding them, and he's loved turtles since he was a boy. On 2022-11-07 he said watching them is calming and fascinating, and he took his pets to the park. On 2022-03-18 he said he likes turtles for their slow pace, calm and low maintenance, and he shares pics of them with Joanna (sent more 2022-04-17 and 2022-09-05; sometimes brings them in the kitchen while he cooks). On 2022-05-20 he introduced a newly adopted pet, Max (a dog; energetic, keeps his other pets active, brings him joy); he asked if Joanna would get a pet. On 2022-05-25 he said he met a nice couple with a dog on a walk with Max; they live nearby and they set up doggy playdates, and Max loves the other dog. That day he also gave Joanna a stuffed animal pup as a reminder of good vibes (she named it Tilly). As of 2022-02-07 he has started making dairy-free treats (coconut milk ice cream, dairy-free chocolate cake with berries); likes coconut, chocolate and mixed berry flavors and plans to try more flavors. On 2022-02-25 he said he made a chocolate and vanilla swirl ice cream for a friend, who loved it. On 2022-04-17 he gave Joanna the recipe: coconut milk, vanilla extract, sugar, pinch of salt; chill, then ice cream maker until scoopable. He is in a vegan diet group; on Friday 2022-06-17 he made vegan ice cream and shared it with the group, and on 2022-06-24 promised Joanna that recipe on 2022-06-25. By 2022-08-14 he had started teaching people how to make dairy-free desserts (finds it fun and rewarding), and sent Joanna another new creamy dairy-free recipe. On Monday 2022-09-05 (per his 2022-09-14 message, "last Monday" ~2022-09-05 or 09-12) he taught vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show (nerve-wracking but a blast, picked up new recipes); Joanna said she'll tune in. His favorite dish is coconut milk ice cream; he also loves dairy-free chocolate mousse. He agreed again to share the recipe with Joanna on 2022-09-14. On 2022-09-05 he asked to join Joanna baking sometime and gave dairy-free tips (margarine or coconut oil instead of butter, check labels). Around 2022-04-08 he dyed his hair a bright, bold color (to stand out) and was thrilled about it; on 2022-04-15 he asked Joanna to keep him posted on her writing. He isn't really into hiking but likes nature and is open to going with Joanna; he mentioned a nice trail just north of where he lives. On 2022-05-12 he agreed to join Joanna on her trails sometime (no date set) and joked he might write his own drama screenplay; when hiking he gets deep in thought about his life or new recipes. Relaxes with pets and hobbies (planned a weekend off with his pets, 2022-08-27/28). On 2022-05-25 Joanna told him she can't wait to show him her finished screenplay and values his opinion; he said he's eager to see it. On 2022-06-03 he encouraged her after her rejection letter. On 2022-06-05 he said Iron Man is his favorite superhero (tech, sarcastic humor); he has an Iron Man figure in his room as a reminder to keep working on his goals, and said he may start a cork board of his own. On 2022-10-25 he said he plans to watch Joanna's newly premiered movie.

files.joanna-recent-writing-update-2022-11.md:
---
name: joanna-recent-writing-update-2022-11
description: Joanna's writing status as of 2022-11-11: filming her own movie from the road-trip script, pitched script to producers 2022-11-08 (they liked it), new love-story script, new thriller, more submissions sent
type: project
---
On 2022-11-11 (12:06 am chat) Joanna said she is finally filming her own movie from the road-trip script. Every day on set is awesome; she loves showing her vision. Coolest moment so far: an actress told her how much she liked the script, which gave her chills. Ask how filming is going.
On 2022-11-07 Joanna said she finished her presentation for producers on Friday 2022-11-04 (tough but looking good). She is writing another movie script, a love story with lots of challenges, inspired by a dream; she hopes to get it on the big screen. She submitted a few more scripts the week before (~late Oct/early Nov 2022) and expects some rejections but won't give up; Nate hopes one becomes her 3rd published movie. She included a childhood letter from her brother (who made her cute notes as kids) at the beginning of the new script, and has started writing down favorite memories.
On 2022-11-09 she said she made a plan to get another script made into a movie and pitched it to producers the day before (2022-11-08); they really liked it, a big confidence boost. She feels she can't stop writing and is working on a new project, a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town. She also shared a sunset photo from a hike last summer near Fort Wayne. Ask about producer follow-ups, the thriller and submission results.

name: nate-update-2022-11-09

On 2022-11-09 Nate said his tournament was pushed back so he tried cooking (homemade coconut ice cream with sprinkles). A later tournament he didn't make the finals in; staying positive. He has offers from gaming teams and is thinking of joining a new team after his next tourney (undecided). He is starting to create gaming content for YouTube (already watching others' videos for research). He got a third turtle from a pet store; the tank is big enough for three. Joanna (allergic) plans to visit him on 2022-11-10 to watch the turtles from a distance, maybe watch a movie or go to the park. Ask about team decision, YouTube channel and the visit.
On 2022-11-10 he took his turtles to the beach in Tampa (calming, he calls them zen masters) and made colorful bowls of coconut milk ice cream with mix-ins; he offered Joanna a taste.
